- Update MyGo to 0.6.2, including Windows second-instance focus and native UI pointer fixes, and the Go build requirement to 1.27.3.
- Remove the hour and minute dropdown grids; keep direct numeric entry and the minus/plus buttons.
- Smooth the desktop widget's rounded edges with alpha composition, including after resizing and display scaling changes.
- Fix clipped tray menu labels by using Windows' native menu layout and system font.
- Match the tray icon to the taskbar's appearance independently of the app theme, and use a stable icon identifier so Windows can remember its notification-area placement.

Download the Windows x64 or ARM64 ZIP, extract it, and run `Countdowner.exe`. Keep the `licenses/` directory. Portable and unsigned.
